author: PoutyJinx
description: A SIN Corporation member lifecycle system with welcomes, account-age screening, latest-arrival lookup, departure logs, and ban appeal DMs.
install_msg: Thank you for installing SINWelcome. Use `[p]sinwelcome setup` or `/sinwelcome setup` to configure it. Enable Server Members Intent and grant View Audit Log for reliable departure classification.
short: SIN Corporation welcomes, security screening, and departure logs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server configuration and one latest-join snapshot containing the member's ID, names, avatar URL, account creation time, join time, and bot status. The snapshot is replaced whenever another member joins.
